about:
First Electronics Inc. operates from Chandler, Arizona, where it provides contract electronics manufacturing services. The company focuses on printed circuit board assembly, cable and wire harness fabrication, and electromechanical box builds, supported by testing and engineering expertise.

Its capabilities span surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, conformal coating, X-ray inspection, and pre- and post-reflow inspection. The shop handles harness assembly, electro-mechanical assembly, and piggyback component placement, accepting jobs from engineering prototypes to large-volume production runs.

The company serves customers in wind energy technology, healthcare and medical devices, and telecommunications. These sectors rely on FEI for assembled boards, cable assemblies, and complete box builds that meet industry-specific quality requirements.

FEI emphasizes that quality begins at the quoting stage and that customer satisfaction is its primary goal. It also highlights the use of advanced, customized test equipment as a differentiator for delivering reliable assemblies.
